title: Live Campaign Blockchain
subtitle: Follow fictional Cedar Valley travelers as their events become signed, linked blocks.
metaDescription: Run multiple traveler scenarios in one campaign, watch a shared blockchain grow, and try editing its signed records. Fictional people, real browser cryptography.
imageAlt: Illustrative mountain landscape for fictional Cedar Valley Tourism
problem: Campaign outcomes follow different traveler paths, while records need a consistent, auditable history.
task: Make live event recording and tamper detection understandable without a complex technical dashboard.
actions: Built a single shared animation clock and atomic commit boundary for traveler milestones and new blocks.
Added five scenarios, interleaved traveler paths, continuous appending, and pause/speed controls.
Kept real hashes, digital signatures, original checkpoints, and editable-copy verification.
results: One campaign accumulates multiple traveler groups without rewriting its earlier records.
An edited record fails verification; exact original records can be restored without re-signing.
notes: Unlisted browser-only educational blockchain with synthetic people and events. All validators run locally; this is not distributed consensus or proof of physical visitation. Illustration assets are derived from approved AI concepts.
